resources.string: Replaces the gallery with generated memories for the last 7 days. Reopen PhotoSwipe to apply.
Forgets every decision: kept, marked, pending favorites and undo history. Your photos and videos are not touched.
Every memory becomes to sort again. This cannot be undone.
Decisions reset. Reopen PhotoSwipe to see it.

Adds real dated photos and videos to the device gallery (folder “PhotoSwipe seed”) for today and the 6 previous days. They belong to PhotoSwipe: Android may skip its trash and favorite dialogues for them. To test those dialogues, push photos with scripts/seed-emulator.sh.
The gallery could not be changed.
